title: Rubber-Hose Errand
premise: A round errand-runner with rubber-hose limbs is sent across a 4:3 stage to fetch a cube. The cube becomes a hat. The errand was always a costume change.
visual: 4:3 TV stage, cream cyclorama, two flat orange curtain legs, muted checkerboard floor. Character: cream sphere head, orange sphere body, black hose limbs, two dot eyes. The cube is a TV-paint flat, not a metal box. Thick ink outline on every form. Not photoreal, not 2D cel on paper — 3D puppets that still read as Saturday-morning.
motion: 0–3s: squash-in from above. 3–12s: walk cycle stage left to the cube. 12–18s: pick up; cube scales onto the head as a hat. 18–24s: two victory hops. 24–32s: exit stage right. Camera locked. Loop from the empty stage.
